newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 ends at second highest close.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 ends at second highest close.

text.p: Britain's leading share index powered to its second highest close on Tuesday in a broad-based rally that continued to feed off a favourable outlook for UK interest rates and sterling.
Sharp gains in oil company shares, including British Petroleum Plc, retailers, led by Kingfisher Plc, and supermarkets also fuelled the nearly one percent rally in the FTSE 100, market sources said.
The FTSE 100 index ended 43.9 points higher at 5,075.8, within sight of its record 5,095.3, in light volume of 718.3 million by 1534 GMT. Advancing stocks led decliners by 71 to 26.
